## Privacy and game integrity / 隐私与游戏完整性

- [ ] The change does not inject into League or read game-process memory
- [ ] The change does not automate clicks, selections, movement, or skill input
- [ ] Captured frames remain local and are not saved or uploaded
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no tokens, cookies, or player identities

## Screenshots / 截图

如果界面有变化，请添加已删除 Riot ID 和玩家姓名的前后对比图。
